'''Trasemene''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] celestial body located in the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]. A part of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] it saw a [[Battle of Trasemene|battle]] where the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] defeated [[Fleet/Legends|that]] of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection|led]] by [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]]. Trasemene also shared its name with the [[Siege of Trasemene]].

==Description==
Trasemene was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Trasemene system/Legends|Trasemene system]], a part of the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]]<ref name="EAOC Trasemene" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Trasemene" /> It was situated on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], which connected it to the [[Handooine system/Legends|Handooine]] and [[Jabiim system/Legends|Jabiim systems]] as well as the [[Sy Myrth system/Legends|Sy Myrth system]]<ref name="Triellus" /> of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:SyMyrthianInsurrection-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Trasemene was the site of a battle during the Sy Myrthian Insurrection.]]
During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Trasemene fell within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] being charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederate forces]] in its vicinity. [[19 BBY/Legends|Three years]] later, after the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars and the [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganization]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Trasemene remained a part of the territory held by the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdout]] [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection|led]] by the [[Sy Myrthian/Legends|Sy Myrthian]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Toora's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was [[Battle of Trasemene|obliterated]] at Trasemene by a [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval force]] of the Empire. Trasemene subsequently came to be situated within Imperial borders by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Trasemene also shared its name with the [[Siege of Trasemene]],<ref name="CSWE Takel">{{CSWECite|III|213|Takel, Grand Admiral Miltin}}</ref> which took place at some point between 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Siege dates">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', which is set before the events of {{Film|V}}, establishes that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was involved in the [[Siege of Trasemene]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the Empire and the events of ''The Empire Strikes Back'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], respectively, the siege must have occurred at some point between those two dates.</ref> The celestial body remained outside the territory of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trasemene was first introduced as part of the name of the Siege of Trasemene in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> In [[2012]], the reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], established Trasemene as a distinct astronomical object.<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Trasemene [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square S-7.<ref name="TEA" />
